name: Innyuu Seijo Anemone ~Mamono Seieki de Kegasare Aheru Tenkaiichi no Chou-baku Binyuu!
original_name: 淫乳聖女アネモネ～魔物精液で穢されアヘる天界一の超爆美乳！
source:
The kingdom of St. Couragia had repelled many an invasion in past, but she-demon Kallen and her hordes struck again and again until Couragia was defeated.
Following the invasion, the kingdom's holy empress Iris was kidnapped, and two weeks later was shown to her people naked and detestably altered.
She had abandoned her faith and submitted completely to sins of the flesh.

Her people were shocked. Kallen reveled in the opprobrium she had caused.
"How lewd your whore Iris has become, eh?! Look at the pitiful sex addict before you! You once worshiped her.. I give you your empress now, knaves! A cumeater! A f*ckwitted slave!"

Later, Kallen return to her quarters and had a drink delivered by a minion.
She only realized too late that the minion was someone who had taken over the real power of her hordes. And the drink was a debilitating sex drug...

Thus, the disgrace and shaming marination of she-demon Kallen begins. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE099321.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
圣库拉吉亚王国过去曾击退过无数次入侵，但女恶魔卡莲及其军团一再来袭，最终攻陷了库拉吉亚。
王国沦陷后，圣女皇伊丽丝遭到绑架。两周后，她赤身裸体地出现在臣民面前，身心都已被改造成令人作呕的模样。
她抛弃信仰，彻底臣服于肉欲之罪。

臣民无不震惊，卡莲则陶醉于自己带来的屈辱。
“瞧瞧你们的婊子伊丽丝变得多淫荡，嗯？！好好看看眼前这个可悲的性瘾患者！你们以前还奉她为神……现在我就把你们的女皇还给你们，贱民们！一个吞精的骚货！一个脑子里只剩挨操的奴隶！”

后来，卡莲回到自己的房间，命一名手下送来酒水。
直到为时已晚，她才意识到这个手下早已夺走了军团的实权，而那杯酒中还掺入了令人虚弱无力的强效春药……

于是，女恶魔卡莲遭受凌辱、一步步浸淫于耻辱之中的故事就此拉开序幕。
